result.title: TopX: Text-to-Motion for Unseen Skeletons from the Skeleton File Alone
result.summary: Text-to-motion models generate for the skeletons they were trained on, while a new character arrives as a skeleton file and nothing else. We study text-to-motion for skeletons that no training clip has used, with no clips of the character, no template, no retargeting and no fine-tuning. We present TopX, a 73M-parameter flow-matching transformer that generates joint rotations and a root trajectory for any kinematic tree from its tree, rest pose and joint names. Motion is normalised by the rest pose and the size of the skeleton, and the rest pose enters as a world-frame descriptor that does not depend on how the rig's author oriented each joint, with rest conventions randomised in training. Attention is factorised over the joints and the frames of a motion and carries a spatial--temporal encoding designed for skeleton graphs of any topology: queries and keys are rotated across joints by a heat-kernel coordinate of the skeleton graph, which is defined for every tree and does not change with the order of its joints or the eigenbasis of its Laplacian, and across frames by a rotary encoding of frame order. To measure what this buys, we build SkelShift: four motion corpora under one codec, 143,334 captioned clips on skeletons of 4 to 142 joints, from which 4,232 clips on 2,043 skeletons are held out by clip, rig, tree class or species and organised along topology, joint count, body plan, species and rig source, and scored by motion quality: Fréchet distances on public kinetic features and on kinematic descriptors, foot skating and ground contact. Against UniMate trained on the same clips, on test rigs without a training clip, TopX lowers the descriptor FID from 5.73 to 4.58 when UniMate's guidance is tuned for the kinetic FID, and the kinetic FID from 1.48 to 0.55 when it is tuned for the descriptor FID, also on motions no training skeleton performs; fewer of its frames sink below the ground.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TopX，一个 73M 参数的 flow-matching transformer，仅依据骨架文件（树结构、静息姿态与关节名）为训练中未出现的骨架生成关节旋转与根轨迹，并构建 SkelShift 基准按拓扑、关节数与体型等维度评测跨骨架泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其面向任意拓扑的骨架图热核坐标时空注意力与静息姿态／尺度归一化，可能为 LVR 中实体关系与几何结构如何编码进内部状态、以及跨结构泛化提供可核查线索，但属动作生成领域，关联需进一步判断。
